items.title: What Is the Digital Battery Passport? A Guide for Battery Manufacturers and OEMs
items.summary_short: From February 18, 2027, light means of transport (LMT) batteries such as e-bikes and e-scooters, industrial batteries above 2 kWh, and EV batteries placed on the EU market must carry a digital battery passport. items.title: Digital Product Passport for Tyres: ESPR Requirements, Timeline, and How to Prepare
items.summary_short: Tyres are listed as a priority product group for the Digital Product Passport in the European Commission's first ESPR Working Plan (April 2025), with an indicative timeline of 2027.
